resume: A band that plays by itself, for dark music: drums, bass, pad, an acid line and a plucked melody, made up on the spot in 21 dark genres (dark techno, EBM, witch house, dark ambient…), ten pieces each. You conduct: chords, breakdowns, effects, mutes; Wander makes the music evolve by itself.

commandes.role: Down an octave, to -3: on a voice's pages, that voice; elsewhere, the whole piece. In the sequencer, the previous drum; in the FX menu, turns every effect off.
Up an octave, to +3, the same way. In the sequencer, the next drum.
Opens and closes the effects menu. Twice quickly: the settings of the last effect played.
Shift, held with another control. Held alone: a card says what it does on the page.
Pad page; again: Pad env, Pad LFO, Chords. With SEL: the voice on screen is played by hand (again: it plays by itself).
Bass page; again: Bass env, Bass LFO, Bass line.
The next chord, on the next bar.
Global page: root, theme, tune, genre; SAVE there stores the piece. Held: the mix map (mutes, solos, scenes, auto-DJ, tap tempo).
Tempo page; again: the Perform screen. Twice quickly: the visualizers. Held: the settings.
A breakdown on the next bar; again: the build and the drop. Held: the drop. On Global: stores the piece.
Acid page; again: Acid env, Acid line, Pluck, Pluck 2, Deja vu.
Drums page; again: Links, Kit, Drum drift, Groove, Steps, Feel, Phrase. Held: the sequencer.
Play and stop. With SEL: Dice, a roll of Wander's changes.
Freeze: the chord holds and the reverb rings on until the next press. With SEL: Capture, the bar played on Jam written into the acid line or the pluck loop.
Volume.
The pages, in order. With HOME held: the tempo. In the FX menu: the effects bank. On the visualizers: the next one.
The piece, 1 to 10. With SEL: it starts on the next bar. With GLO held: the genre.
The scale's mode, which sets the mood. With SEL: the sound of the voice on screen (on the drum pages, the whole kit).
The scale: each key adds or removes its note (the root stays). On the pages of a voice played by hand and on Jam: that voice. In the sequencer: the 16 steps. In the FX menu: the effects.
The same as the white keys.

gestes: SEL + SAVE held 1.5 s on Global: the piece goes back to factory.
ENV, LFO, ARP, EDIT, REC, OCT- or OCT+ held alone 0.9 s: a card says what it does.
An effect key: a tap latches it; held longer, the effect plays while held.
A scene key held 0.6 s stores the scene; a tap recalls it.
OCT- and OCT+ held 5 s: update mode.

modes.texte: The page after Global, seven pages on the SELECT dial: Jam, Jam Sound, Jam Steps, Jam Steps 2, Jam Arp, Jam Arp 2, Jam Arp 3. You play a voice on the keys, with an arpeggiator; Jam Steps shows the line (Pluck or Acid) as 16 steps on the white keys, REC records into it live, SEL + REC clears it.

Two settings pages (SEL + FX, then the dial to WANDER and WANDER 2) that make the music evolve by itself: between pieces and genres, swapped sounds, drifting knobs, muted layers, on the schedule and by the amount you set. Never the kick or snare, never your stored pieces.

a_savoir: Wander, Auto FX and Drum Vary settings are not kept at power-off.
